identity.title: [v0.92][WP-14 follow-up] Retain native proof and make post-merge validation squash-safe

values.summary: Stop for a different fresh full-package review. Only after PASS: implement and review producer head H; generate fresh Linux/macOS proof; retain exact-allowlist H2 with an exact retained-surface manifest and unchanged eight-path proof contract; independently review H2; retain the manifest-bound review receipt in allowlisted H3; and prove later heads can authenticate the reviewed H2 retained surface without H2 Git objects while always enforcing seventeen-path protected-source equality.

steps.action: Complete typed cards and machine contracts for exact H/H2/H3 path, digest, status, retained-surface, and review-receipt rules; then stop for a different fresh independent full-package review.

Only after second-review PASS, restore c640 provenance and implement the historical wrapper, fresh producer/workflow, retained validator, exact diff enforcement, retained-surface manifest, and adversarial fixtures; obtain exact-head implementation review at H.

Publish reviewed H, run fresh native Actions at exact H, and create H2 containing the required denominator, exact ten evidence paths, retained-surface manifest, and only named typed lifecycle paths while all eight proof-contract paths remain unchanged.

Independently review exact H2, create H3 with only the H2-review receipt plus named lifecycle changes, and prove later-head receipt and retained-surface validation works even when H2 commit and tree objects are unavailable; shepherd checks without merging.

invariants: The retained packet bytes and recorded source-run identities remain immutable
Every referenced artifact is repository-relative and confined beneath issue evidence
Current protected-source equality is mandatory in both ancestry and equivalence modes
Squash/rebase changes may alter commit identity but cannot excuse protected-byte drift
risks: An ancestry-only rule would fail after squash even when source bytes are identical
A digest-only rule could omit a protected path or fail to bind runner provenance
Restoring packet files without a final-head validator would repeat the false-green contract
Editing #209 rendered cards directly could corrupt immutable lifecycle history
A preparation PR could be mistaken for implementation completion if its non-claims are unclear
stop_conditions: A different fresh independent full-package review is missing, stale, or has any unresolved actionable finding
Any product, workflow, validator, evidence, or publication change occurs before that review passes
Historical restored bytes differ from the exact ten-path denominator or the fresh native proof at reviewed H is unavailable

H2 lacks the required retained-surface manifest, denominator, or exact ten evidence paths, or its name/status diff contains any path outside those required files and the exact fourteen lifecycle paths
Any of the exact eight proof-contract paths changes from H through reviewed H2
H2-to-H3 changes include anything except the independently reviewed receipt and exact named lifecycle paths

The H3 receipt does not bind H, H2, available tree identities, exact H-to-H2 diff/status digest, retained-surface manifest digest, denominator/proof digests, review scope, reviewer identity, result, and no-drift verdict
Later-head validation requires H2 commit/tree objects instead of reconstructing exact retained-surface equality from the manifest and receipt
The validator cannot reject retained-surface, receipt, protected-source, arbitrary H-to-H2 unprotected-source, proof-tool, workflow, semantic, provenance, path/status, or unrelated drift
Any action would modify terminal #209 truth, use AWS, merge the PR, or close #142
